title: blob loss: Instance Imbalance Aware Loss Functions for Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: Per GT component Dice with all other components masked, averaged over components and added to a global loss.
adaptation: Merged crack instances and inactive components; reference arm for the benchmark's loss suite.
min_experiment: Arm: house + blob Dice on crack/inactive, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metric: component F1 and relF1@2. Kill: no component F1 gain >= 0.02.
evidence: Five 3D tasks: F1 +5% MS lesions, +3% liver tumour, +2% microscopy vs soft Dice. In BiCC's comparison blob loss lowered precision and Dice on 4 of 5 datasets.
